comparison: Trails zero-state law4-sign-mp (12/15 vs 10/14) despite adding 1 state tensor/param, mirroring unified-v11 vs law4-muon-m: adding momentum to L_infinity sign geometry smears heteroscedastic t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig 0.4993 -> 0.4084) and softens grid100 center accuracy (0.0983 -> 0.1124).
conclusion: 1-state Lion-style smooth sign momentum (beta1=0.5, beta2=0.9, 1 state/param, 0 NS) + MP + peak_rms + secant band achieves 10/14 graded PASS (4 numerical FAIL, 1 contention-TIMEOUT on five_word_joint_smoke, 1 prereq-gated grid100_mlp16) on r4-occam-ablation-v1. Passes gaussian1d_smoke/stability (ks=0.0229), zero_tanh_smoke (mae=0.00135), ring16 (hq=0.9902), vector_unequal_mass/width (hq=0.9990/0.9985, eig=0.4652/0.5904), img_bars4 (4/4 hq=1.0), both >500x Nash tasks (hq=0.9756/0.9644), and t3_iso_horizon_saddle_shift (hq=0.9453). Fails grid100 (final prec=0.9928, ctr=0.1124 yet missed live suffix), t3_iso_scale_mass_8x (eig=0.4084), model_ddgan_gaussian_chain (t1_q0_mean=0.4871), and zero_tanh_rail_escape (mae=0.00253 final yet missed check).
